messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners & timelines for the remediation items and fold the tests into our recurring evals. I sketched a minimal plan below. Can people claim ownership?

marta: Ack. Can you list the concrete test additions you want? promptsets / load / chaos?

alex: Yes — three buckets: 1) regression prompt-set (targeting the failure prompts from the incident), 2) scalable load test (replicate burst pattern we saw), 3) a targeted chaos drill (KV eviction + model fallback) as a monthly exercise. Also add the regression to CI gates for the affected route.

raj: I can take the load test work. Plan: implement a k6 script that reproduces the sig spike pattern and run it in staging weekly for 2 weeks then move to nightly smoke if stable. timeline: prototype by next Wed, staged runs the following week.

sophia: I will own the prompt-set regression. Will extract the failure set, add 50 counterexamples, and add automated scoring with existing eval harness. timeline: initial promptset + baseline run by Fri.

marta: I'll own the chaos drill orchestration and runbook updates. proposal: quarterly chaos with a lighter monthly tabletop. For the drill, we simulate KV eviction + degraded model variant fallback. timeline: tabletop next Tue, drill in 3 weeks.

alex: Thanks — that's perfect. Action items (short):
- A1 (owner: sophia) prompt-set extraction + add to regression harness (due: Fri)
- A2 (owner: raj) load test prototype k6 script + staged runs (due: next Wed prototype)
- A3 (owner: marta) chaos runbook + tabletop (due: next Tue), drill (due: in 3 weeks)
- A4 (owner: alex) add regression gate to CI + create dashboard alerts for recurrence patterns (due: EOD Mon)

ci-bot: Created tickets: RP-1123 (promptset), LT-2244 (load test), CD-3310 (chaos). Links: https://redwood.internal/issue/RP-1123, https://redwood.internal/issue/LT-2244, https://redwood.internal/issue/CD-3310

raj: Slight tweak — for the load test we should parameterize sequence length and kv hit-rate. I'll add a config block:
```
{k6: {vus: 50, duration: '5m'}, params: {seq_len: [64, 128, 256], kv_hit: [0.6, 0.9]}}
```

alex: Good call. Make sure we record the seed and the exact request distribution so the CI rerun is deterministic.

marta: For owner rotations: I propose the oncall rotates the chaos drill owner quarterly, while platform retains remediation owners for the first 90 days, then we rotate to a platform-ops pool for ongoing maintenance. Thoughts?

sophia: That sounds reasonable. For the prompt-set we should tag examples with incident id and add a small summary header so future triage finds them quickly.

alex: Agreement on rotation. I'll add a swimlane in the weekly eng-platform board and add the 90-day review checkpoint. Also adding a recurring calendar event: "Incident-driven regression review" every Monday for 8 weeks.

marta: I'll update the runbook with attack patterns and expected failure modes + rollback steps. Will attach the tabletop agenda.

raj: Will open a PR for k6 script tomorrow and link LT-2244.

ci-bot: Deployment note: staging runs scheduled via LT-2244 job: cron @daily starting 1729960000.

alex: Final asks: please add estimated effort in the tickets (<4d or 4-10d). Once tickets are updated, I'll mark them as blockers for the release if not complete by their due dates. :thumbsup:

sophia: Done. RP-1123 marked ~2d.

raj: LT-2244 marked ~5d (prototype 2d, stabilization 3d).

marta: CD-3310 marked ~3d for runbook + tabletop prep.

alex: Great — everyone, ping me if you need help. We'll re-check status on Monday standup and I’ll post a brief summary to the postmortem thread.

marta: Thanks. :white_check_mark:

sophia: Thanks.

raj: On it.
